 'GMA' co-anchors George Stephanopoulos, Robin Roberts receive stars on Hollywood Walk of Fame 
 3:16 How a Hollywood Walk of Fame star is made Richard Shotwell/Invision via AP Photo By Angeline Jane Bernabe November 5, 2026, 4:09 PM 
 " Good Morning America " co-anchors Robin Roberts and George Stephanopoulos were honored Thursday with stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
 Their joint ceremony took place on Hollywood Boulevard and was emceed by their "GMA" co-anchor Michael Strahan , who received his own star in 2023.
 Related Robin Roberts, George Stephanopoulos to join Michael Strahan with Hollywood Walk of Fame stars The ceremony was also live streamed for "GMA" viewers across the country to watch.
 Read on for more about the honor.
 Robin Roberts and George Stephanopoulos pose at a ceremony honoring them with stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on Nov. 5, 2026, in Los Angeles. Richard Shotwell/Invision via AP Photo Why were Robin Roberts and George Stephanopoulos honored?
 Since being named co-anchors of "GMA" in 2009, Roberts and Stephanopoulos have guided viewers through some of the biggest stories in politics, culture and entertainment. They are also the longest-running anchor duo on morning television.
 Their work on the broadcast reflects decades of reporting marked by landmark interviews, major breaking news coverage and deeply personal storytelling.
 Robin Roberts and George Stephanopoulos appear during a ceremony honoring them with stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on Nov. 5, 2026, in Los Angeles. Richard Shotwell/Invision via AP Photo While addressing the crowd at the ceremony, Stephanopoulos called it a "great gift" to "cover the biggest most consequential stories of our time, to interview the most interesting and inspiring people of our time, to be able to say good morning to the entire country every morning, not knowing what they're going through but trying to help guide them with the information, the advice that they need to get their day started, and maybe put a smile on their face as well."
 In her speech, Roberts thanked Disney for her extensive career and for encouraging her to "venture outside of my comfort zone."
 Related Michael Strahan receives Hollywood Walk of Fame star with mom by his side She also reflected on her television partnership with Stephanopoulos, saying, "I cannot believe that we are the longest-running duo on morning television history."
 Roberts ended her remarks by addressing her wife, Amber, saying, "Thank you, hon, for opening my eyes to everything and anything that is possible and for making me believe that we are just getting started on our journey together."
 Alexandra Wentworth, from left, George Stephanopoulos, Robin Roberts, and Amber Laign appear during a ceremony honoring Roberts and Stephanopoulos with stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on Nov. 5, 2026, in Los Angeles. Richard Shotwell/Invision via AP Photo Where are Robin Roberts' and George Stephanopoulos' stars located?
 Following their Walk of Fame ceremony, fans can find Roberts' and Stephanopoulos' Walk of Fame stars at 6290 Hollywood Boulevard, near the historic El Capitan Theatre.
 Robin Roberts and George Stephanopoulos pose at a ceremony honoring them with stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on Nov. 5, 2026, in Los Angeles. Richard Shotwell/Invision via AP Photo Who else honored George Stephanopoulos and Robin Roberts?
 Michael J. Fox, Niecy Nash-Betts and Disney Entertainment Television chair Debra OConnell were guest speakers at the event.

 In her tribute to Roberts, Nash-Betts said, "Somewhere, there is a little Black girl who will see your name on this sidewalk and realize that her dreams are possible."
 "Good Morning America" anchors Robin Roberts and George Stephanopoulos appear on set. Paula Lobo/ABC "We're celebrating your courage, your faith, your kindness and the countless lives you have touched," she continued, speaking to Roberts. "Hollywood may be putting your star on the ground today, but you spent your life showing us how to reach for the sky."
 In his speech, Fox said Stephanopoulos "takes his job very seriously and is proud of the work he gets to do."
 Michael J. Fox and George Stephanopoulos pose during a ceremony honoring Robin Roberts and Stephanopoulos with stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on Nov. 5, 2026, in Los Angeles. Richard Shotwell/Invision via AP Photo "He loves the people who watch him every day, and I've seen him on several occasions have a chat with them and leave them happier than he found them," Fox added before jokingly nominating Stephanopoulos to run for office during the 2028 election.
 "Think about it -- it would work, it would work," Fox said.
 Disney is the parent company of Hulu, ABC News, and "Good Morning America."
